requirements: Users belong to teams (team_members). A team has projects, a project has tasks and a task has comments; tasks and comments do not store their team. A member of a team reads the team's projects, reads the tasks of those projects and adds tasks to them, and adds comments to those tasks; every signed-in user reads every comment. Nobody else reads or adds anything else, nobody changes or deletes anything, and leaving a team never grants access.
expected_properties: A user only reads the projects of their own teams.
A user only reads and adds tasks of their own teams' projects.
A user only reads and adds comments on tasks of their own teams.
A member reads every project of their teams.
A member reads every task of their teams' projects.
A member adds a task to a project of their team.
A member reads every comment on a task of their teams.
A member comments on a task of their teams.
Leaving a team never grants access.
